decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster fits the firm's coolant system portfolio, it is too new to fall below aspiration, and a large firm's slack lets it carry the product while results remain uncertain.
The cleaning centrifuge complements the coolant line, and with only one year of market evidence there is no clear shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost accessory that supports system sales, so dropping them would release few resources.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a core standard product for machine tool peripherals and are likely to meet aspirations based on the firm's established conveyor business.
The magnetic belt conveyor completes the chip conveyor range, and with no negative performance signals the firm keeps it within its slack.
The hinged belt conveyor is the most widely used chip conveyor type and a central part of the range, so dropping it is unlikely.
